title: Incorrect Usage
slide_intent: Recognize which small changes can make an icon look soft or excessively pointed. Checking the enlarged contour reveals why the reduced silhouette has changed.
strategic_value: Instacart can keep the pin and flag in the same geometric family as the symbol by correcting the particular corner that drifts.
demonstration: The symbol remains the reference on the first grid. Red rings identify rounding at the point of the pin, rounding at a right angle and an overly sharp flag angle. Small red specimens repeat the altered forms below.
practical_value: Mark the exact contour that needs correction. Check the tip, right-angle transitions and angle of the flag cut at display size.

content_islands.name: Reference and brief
content_islands.spec: Place the corner guidance at left and retain the enlarged original symbol on the first grid.

content_islands.name: Marked deviations
content_islands.spec: Put the pin and flag beside the symbol. Circle each problem in red and tie its caption to that contour.

content_islands.name: Reduced examples
content_islands.spec: Repeat the neutral symbol and the altered icons below their corresponding grids, using red for the incorrect examples.
